build.buildCommand: yarn install && yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend prisma generate && yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend build && sed -i '/apps\/frontend/d' package.json && rm -rf apps/frontend && rm -rf node_modules && yarn install --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline

deploy.startCommand: yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend prisma migrate deploy && yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend start
